text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Australia, Nov 18 - COAL - Queensland, Abbot Point - one vessel loading, 5 due by 9/12. No delays. Dalrymple Bay - two vessels loading, 2 waiting, 20 due by 3/12. Approx. 1-2 Days delay expected. Hay Point - one vessel loading, 3 waiting, 7 due by 29/11. Approx. 2-3 Days delay expected. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna 1 vessel loading, 2 waiting, 21 due by 26/12. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Barney Point berth vacant, 6 due by 5/12. No delays. Brisbane - berth vacant, 2 vessels due by 29/11. No delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle - Kooragang K4/5 shiploading resumed at 1937 hrs 15/11 after breakdown earlier in the day. One vessel loading, 21 due by 5/12. No delays Channel (dyke) 2 vessels loading, 1 waiting, 23 due by 4/12. Approx 1 Days delay expected. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 2 waiting, 17 due by 22/12, approx 1-2 Days delay expected.

IRON ORE - Western Australia, Port Hedland - BHP iron ore, Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) A Berth 5 vessels due by 27/11, B Berth 6 vessels due by 27/11, 3 other vessels due by 30/11. BHP iron ore, Goldsworthy (Finucane Is) 1 vessel loading, 2 due by 27/11, 1 other due by 24/11. Dampier - Parker Point maintenance shutdown for 5 days from 1/12. 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored, 5 due by 25/11. East Intercourse island 4 vessels due by 25/11. Dampier line-up 6 vessels due by 29/11, 5 for East Intercourse Is, 1 for Parker Point. Port Walcott - five vessels due by 1/12.

GRAIN - Queensland, Nov 20 - Mackay - no vessels due. Gladstone - one vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 1 due 25/11 to load wheat. Brisbane - three vessels waiting to load wheat, 4 due by 30/11 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley.

New South Wales, Newcastle - one vessel loading wheat, 5 due by 18/12 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 barley. Port Kembla - six vessels due by December, 2 to load barley, 4 wheat. Victoria, Geelong - one vessel loading oats, 1 due 22/11 to load peas/ canola. Portland - five due by 15/12, 3 to load peas, 2 barley.

South Australia, Port Pirie - one vessel due 23/11 to load barley. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading barley, 3 due by 27/11 of which 1 to load wheat, 1 barley/bagged oats, 1 barley. Thevenard, Wallaroo, Ardrossan, Port Giles - no vessels due. Port Lincoln - one vessel waiting to load barley.

Western Australia, Geraldton - one vessel loading wheat/ barley, 6 due by 28/11, 4 to load wheat, 1 lupins, 1 barley. Kwinana - one vessel loading wheat, 10 due by 6/12 of which 9 to load wheat, 1 wheat/lupins. Shiploader 3 out of service 14/11 for modifications for approx month. Loading to continue through shiploaders 1, 2 and 4 if necessary. Albany - two due by 3/12, both to load wheat. Esperance - one due 29/11 to load barley.
